asks.ask: Extrapolated onset 계산 및 표시 (접선: DTG max, 기준선: 500°C 중량)

code:
import numpy as np
mask = (x >= 450) & (x <= 800)
if not np.any(mask):
    mask = (x >= 450)
y2_masked = y2[mask]
x_masked = x[mask]
idx_max_local = np.argmax(y2_masked)
idx_max_global = np.where(x == x_masked[idx_max_local])[0][0]
t_x = x[idx_max_global]
t_y = y1[idx_max_global]
window_size = 5
start_idx = max(0, idx_max_global - window_size)
end_idx = min(len(x), idx_max_global + window_size + 1)
slope = np.polyfit(x[start_idx:end_idx], y1[start_idx:end_idx], 1)[0]
baseline_y = np.interp(500, x, y1)
if slope != 0:
    x_onset = t_x + (baseline_y - t_y) / slope
else:
    x_onset = t_x
x_line_start = max(x[0], t_x - 50)
x_line_end = min(t_x + 50, x[-1])
y_line_start = t_y + slope * (x_line_start - t_x)
y_line_end = t_y + slope * (x_line_end - t_x)
ax1.plot([x_line_start, x_line_end], [y_line_start, y_line_end], 'r--', label='Tangent')
ax1.axhline(y=baseline_y, xmin=(np.searchsorted(x, max(x[0], t_x-100))/len(x)), xmax=(np.searchsorted(x, min(x[-1], t_x+100))/len(x)), color='gray', linestyle=':', label='Baseline (500°C)')
ax1.scatter([x_onset], [baseline_y], color='red', zorder=5)
ax1.annotate(f'Onset: {x_onset:.1f} °C', xy=(x_onset, baseline_y), xytext=(x_onset + 20, baseline_y + 5), arrowprops=dict(facecolor='black', shrink=0.05, width=1, headwidth=8))
handles, labels = ax1.get_legend_handles_labels()
by_label = dict(zip(labels, handles))
ax1.legend(by_label.values(), by_label.keys(), loc='best')
